$comment: Allowlist of custom properties that theme.css references with var() but never defines. The contract is: a NEW undefined reference fails the test until it is registered here with a reason. Categories: obsidianBuiltin (Obsidian app.css), styleSettingsInjected (written at runtime by the Style Settings plugin from a setting id), externallyProvided (supplied by a library or community plugin), patterns (generated families, matched by regex with a pinned count). See docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md.

generatedFrom.note: Regenerated after merging origin/main and fixing the unquoted --willemstad-release token. Five properties left the list when the KNOWN-ISSUES #4 defects were fixed; the four remaining are supplied outside the theme.

patterns.name: ch-colour-intermediates
patterns.why: Per-step lightness/chroma/hue components of the generated colour system. Each is used as var(--x-tmp, var(--x-pax, var(--x-set, <default>))): only the innermost -set value (or the literal default) is ever defined, so the outer two are intentionally unset. Style Settings writes the -tmp / -pax value when the user overrides a colour. See src/colour/.

patterns.name: colour-palette-intermediates
patterns.why: Same three-level override chain as above, for the named palette colours (red/green/blue/accent/selection/…). -tmp = user template, -pax = per-theme override.

externallyProvided.name: --pcr-color
externallyProvided.provider: Pickr (the colour-picker library Style Settings bundles)
externallyProvided.why: Used as var(--pcr-color, var(--col-highlight-N)). The fallback is the tell: the author knew the property may be absent. Pickr sets it on the element it renders.

externallyProvided.name: --lane-width
externallyProvided.why: Read on .kanban-plugin__lane-wrapper. The plugin owns lane sizing; the theme only overrides the width when a single-lane option is active.

externallyProvided.name: --layer-modal
externallyProvided.why: The theme defines no --layer-* property yet reads one for z-index, which is the signature of a host-provided token rather than a theme token.

externallyProvided.name: --corner-smoothing
externallyProvided.why: Feeds -electron-corner-smoothing, an Electron-only property. The value has to come from the host; the theme has nothing to compute it from.
